recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由大小不一的脂肪空泡與藍色基質構成，其間幾乎看不到造血細胞，周圍僅有紅血球背景，符合低細胞性（paucicellular）骨髓，提示再生不良性貧血。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of round, variably sized clear fat vacuoles
Intervening blue-staining stromal strands with very few recognizable hematopoietic cells
No megakaryocytes or clusters of granulocytic/erythroid precursors identifiable in the particle
Background of peripheral blood red cells with sparse scattered nucleated cells
Low magnification; individual cell morphology cannot be assessed
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a marrow particle composed predominantly of adipocyte vacuoles and stromal elements, with markedly reduced hematopoietic cells. Megakaryocytes and trilineage precursors are not appreciated within the particle, and the surrounding trails consist largely of peripheral blood red cells. Evaluation of cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings indicate a paucicellular (fatty) marrow particle, consistent with aplastic anemia in the appropriate clinical context; correlation with the trephine biopsy and PNH flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: A hemodilute sample lacks particles or shows cellular particles diluted by blood, whereas here the particles themselves are present but composed almost entirely of fat.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic residual precursors, increased blasts, or clonal cytogenetics, which require assessment of the residual cells and biopsy rather than particle cellularity alone.
Elderly marrow may be fatty but retains proportional trilineage hematopoiesis in particles and is not accompanied by pancytopenia.
